title: Build-hygiene: core-alone boundary proof masked by stale tsc --build tsbuildinfo
description: Surfaced during cck.6 review. The epic acceptance #1 boundary proof (clear dist, build core alone, assert packages/core/dist/index.js exists) is fragile: 'tsc --build' is incremental and keys off packages/core/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo. If only dist is cleared but tsbuildinfo is left, tsc reports up-to-date, emits nothing, exits 0 — making the core-alone build appear to produce no dist and the full build fail with TS2307 (a false negative observed by a reviewer). From a fully clean state (dist AND tsbuildinfo cleared) the full and core-only builds both exit 0 and emit dist/index.js (verified). Fix: make the boundary-proof procedure (and any CI step) clear tsbuildinfo too, or use 'tsc --build --force' / add a 'clean' script, so the proof is deterministic. Pure infra/hygiene — no product code change.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #10 (branch work/cck-followups); typecheck clean, 166 tests pass.
